evidence.title: GitHub - irsyadadl/intentui: Intent UI is a chill set of React components, built on top of React Aria Components and Tailwind CSS.

name: Intent UI
summary: Copy-and-paste React components built on React Aria and Tailwind CSS, installed via the shadcn CLI.
description: 80+ accessible React components built on React Aria Components and styled with Tailwind CSS, added by copy-paste or with the shadcn CLI. Includes blocks (sidebar, navbar, auth, charts), starter kits for Next.js, Laravel, TanStack Router and Vite, themes, dark-mode guides and an MCP server; a separate premium set offers more blocks, patterns and templates.
contains: 80+ components in 12 groups (collections, colors, controls, date & time, forms, overlays …)
592 shadcn registry items; add all with @intentui/all
starter kits: Next.js, Laravel, TanStack Router, Vite
MIT licensed; premium blocks/templates offered separately
